A new draft for agent identity

The working group published a new draft today. It describes how an agent proves who it acts for, and how a server checks that proof before it answers.

The text builds on the earlier revision and on our background notes. An old link uses plain http.

Subscribe to our newsletter.

Implementers are asked to send feedback to the list before the next meeting, so the open questions about key rotation and delegation can be closed in time.
